summary: The Level-1 routine classifier reads coverage for the whole planned region; make it read the per-file fact the authority router already records, so a plan holding a file the graph never examined is never classified routine.
plan: routingRecord (internal/workflow/engine.go) carries only the region-level scoped preflight; classifyRoutine (internal/workflow/routine.go) reads scoped.Coverage.Proven() for the region, which is proven the moment one planned file carries anchors. Carry the router's per-file fact -- the unexamined architectural files established at routing -- on routingRecord, set it where setRouting records the routing evidence, and make classifyRoutine block when any planned file is unexamined, naming the file. ClassifyCounterfactual (internal/workflow/routine_scan.go) has no routing record, so it records the condition as assumed rather than tested, like conditions 8 and 9. Add the regression test beside the existing routine tests. No change in any other behaviour.
steps: Add the unexamined planned files to routingRecord and record them in setRouting from the action that was routed.
Add one blocking condition to classifyRoutine: any planned file the graph never examined blocks, naming the file; a record with none behaves as today.
In ClassifyCounterfactual, where no routing record exists, record the new condition as assumed, as conditions 8 and 9 are.

Add a regression test in internal/workflow/routine_test.go: a region-proven scoped preflight with one unexamined planned file is not routine, and the same preflight with none unexamined classifies as before.
Run gofmt -l cmd internal, go vet ./..., and go test ./... .
consequences: A plan carrying a file the graph never examined can no longer be classified routine on its neighbour's anchors; plans with every file examined classify exactly as before. No routing, authority or admission behaviour changes.

claims.statement: classifyRoutine reads scoped.Coverage.Proven(), a region-level verdict, at routine.go condition 3.
routingRecord holds Policy, Scoped, Claims and Planned, and no per-file coverage fact.
Action.Unexamined is established per file at routing and is available where setRouting is called.
